articles.summary: With GelrinC CE-marked in Europe and in a U.S. Phase III trial, Regentis hires Ori Gon, a CFO who has raised $150M+, to drive commercialization.

articles.summary: Former CartiHeal clinical ops head behind Agili-C’s FDA ok and $330M sale joins Regentis to guide GelrinC trials, EU rollout plans and U.S. approval path.
